subject: Re: Agile Deliberation status: index built, early pilot signal
body:
Yusuf, thanks.

Decisions from the pilot review:

1. Pilot extends to three concepts and twelve raters through end of May; the agreement delta stays the headline metric.
2. We defer the full 400M index — the sharded build keeps eating your time, and the pilot runs fine on the 40M subsample. Revisit in Q3 planning.
3. Quentin writes up the deliberation-flow findings for the rater-tooling leads by May 22; I take the readout on May 25.

Good project — the kappa movement is the strongest tooling result this quarter in the portfolio.

Dmitri
